title: Crypto & Identity: Scope boundary decision log and QA criteria
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Clarify scope and acceptance criteria for SSO/SAML, RBAC roles, and KMS/HSM audit obligations for private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Produce a decision log that defines what Redwood will deliver in the Private GA, what will be deferred, and measurable QA criteria for each control area.
background: Multiple enterprise deals flagged ambiguous responsibilities in keying, RBAC scoping, and audit retention. Sales and Security requested a crisp boundary document to avoid delays during onboarding. This ticket collates decisions from PM, Security, and Eng and specifies QA checks that the onboarding team will run.
decision_log: 2026-01-12: Agreed to support SAML 2.0 full IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows for Private GA. 2026-01-15: KMS integration must support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP KMS initially; HSM-backed KMS optional milestone for GA+1. 2026-01-19: RBAC will ship with Role templates (Admin, DevOps, Viewer) and fine-grained attribute-based access as roadmap item. 2026-01-28: Audit logs must include token-level request metadata and be exportable to customer SIEM via syslog/S3.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: end-to-end tests validating IdP metadata import, SAML assertions mapping to RBAC roles, and SP-initiated login flows. RBAC: ability to create roles, assign principals (SAML groups and service accounts), and enforce read/write restrictions on model endpoints. KMS/HSM: ability to register customer-managed KMS key and demonstrate encryption-at-rest for model artifacts; audit entry created for key usage. Audit logging: retention config exposed, logs include request id, model id, user id, action, timestamp, and are exportable to S3 and syslog.
implementation_notes: Eng to implement SAML using existing auth library; Security to provide threat model annex. For KMS, integrate with Redwood key proxy; HSM support gated by additional compliance testing. RBAC to reuse console role model; add SAML group mapping UI. Provide migration path for existing accounts.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: KMS key rotation complexity. Mitigation: automate rotation testing in CI/CD and document operational runbook. Risk: SAML attribute mapping ambiguity. Mitigation: provide mapping UI and default templates; include conformance tests with common IdPs (Okta, Azure AD).
open_questions: 1) Will customers be able to supply HSM-stored keys during GA? 2) What is the default audit log retention period for GA? 3) Do we require SOC2 evidence updates before offering HSM option?
work_items: Create PRD annex (confluence:/r/redwood/priv-security-2026), implement SAML e2e tests (GH: redwood/infra#8124), KMS registration flow (GH: redwood/keystore#129), RBAC mapping UI mockups (drive:/designs/rbacs-mapping-v2), audit export CLI tool (GH: redwood/tools#416).
